rows.note: Bare convention token, not a held path. `git -C LANE cat-file -t 8ca67421111fa354b47b803358391d0b07fc6db9:plans/round-N-record-draft.md` -> `fatal: path 'plans/round-N-record-draft.md' does not exist`; `git -C LANE ls-tree --name-only 8ca67421111fa354b47b803358391d0b07fc6db9:plans` lists completion-evidence.md, round-10.plan.md, round-11.plan.md, round-2.plan.md, round-3.plan.md and the round-4..round-10 {plan,record-draft} pairs, no `round-N*` file. The clause itself holds for the concrete files: `git -C LANE cat-file -t 8ca67421111fa354b47b803358391d0b07fc6db9:plans/round-4-record-draft.md` (and the same for round-7 and round-10) -> blob, so plans/round-4-record-draft.md .. plans/round-10-record-draft.md resolve. `absent` is the frozen counter's sanctioned route for an unresolvable path pointer (.ufo/evidence/round-49/c1/measure.py:271-278: verdict `absent` + file null), and the control harness writes exactly that row shape (.ufo/evidence/round-49/control/c1-controls.py:123). No excerpt: the pointed text does not exist and the absent branch reads no excerpt. The map floor is 17 (.ufo/evidence/round-49/c1/measure.py:79), so the pointer cannot be deleted; the proposed fix is a clarification only, verified against the frozen extractor (c1.extract on the edited section text returns the same 17 pointers in the same order with ordinal 12 raw unchanged). For the L1: the CTL_K2 'two bare map pointers' are ordinals 0 and 1 (bare line pointers `:1294-1297` and `:1246-1270`, file null, kind line, which get no absent carve-out), not this path token.

proposed_fix.skill_old: `plans/round-N.plan.md`, `plans/round-N-record-draft.md` | each round's plan and record by convention (rounds 4–10);
proposed_fix.skill_new: `plans/round-N.plan.md`, `plans/round-N-record-draft.md` | each round's plan and record by convention (rounds 4–10; `N` is a placeholder, not a file — the concrete files are the round-4 through round-10 plan and record-draft pairs that `plans/` holds);
proposed_fix.why: The literal token resolves to no blob, so a reader who tries to open it chases a path the lane does not hold; the placeholder is what the row means. The edit names no new file token, so the extractor's pointer set is unchanged (17 pointers, ordinal 12 raw still `plans/round-N-record-draft.md`, kind path, file null) and the row stays `absent` per measure.py:271-278. fixed_file/fixed_ranges/fixed_excerpt are null because no target text exists to quote.
